label: What was the stress perfusion visual hyperaemia? (Does the bulk of the myocardium light up?)- Myofit sub-study
meta_rows: What was the stress perfusion visual hyperaemia? (Does the bulk of the myocardium light up?)- Myofit sub-study
Quantitative Perfusion(QC) from the MyoFit study.
cat_rows: Quantifies myocardial blood flow from perfusion MRI- uses the signal contrast from the qualitative stress perfusion images and derives a quantitative blood flow. This test was done on the 1946 birth cohort participants who took part in the Myofit (2020-2024) sub-study.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
